name: What steps are involved in professional bathroom door frame restoration?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional bathroom door frame restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairs begin with a thorough inspection of the jamb, hinges, and surrounding drywall for moisture damage and out-of-plumb angles. The technician removes the door slab and damaged casing, then cuts away rotted jamb material or extracts the entire frame. After treating or replacing any damaged structural framing, a new moisture-resistant jamb is leveled, shimmed, and secured to the rough opening. Finally, the door is rehung to test swing and latch clearance, casing is installed, and all gaps are sealed with paintable waterproof caulk.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing damaged wood, inspecting structural studs, installing and shimming a plumb jamb, rehanging the door, and applying waterproof sealant and trim.
